query: I told my employer I was taking paternity leave and my shifts were cut. I want to know if this is paternity discrimination and who can help. England. Who helps?
title: Paternity discrimination at work: who helps

freeHelp.title: Working Families
freeHelp.blurb: for parents and carers needing advice on maternity and paternity leave and discrimination. They also provide basic benefits advice

freeHelp.title: YESS Law
freeHelp.blurb: offers affordable advice to employees and employers who want to resolve problems at work

freeHelp.title: BPP Law School Employment Law Telephone Advice Line (ELTAL)
freeHelp.blurb: an advice line offering initial advice to callers. Leave a message and a student volunteer will call back.

freeHelp.title: Free Representation Unit
freeHelp.blurb: provides legal advice, case preparation and advocacy in employment, social security, and some criminal injury compensation tribunal cases

freeHelp.title: Citizens Advice Adviceline (England)
freeHelp.blurb: Free phone advice on consumer, debt, housing, employment and more — routes to local help.
